findings.description: The KMS key does not have 'enable_key_rotation' set to true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled by default, weakening long-term cryptographic hygiene for a key protecting audit trail data.

No explicit 'policy' attribute is defined for the KMS key, so it falls back to the default AWS-managed key policy which grants full access (kms:*) to the entire AWS account via IAM, potentially allowing any IAM principal with appropriate IAM permissions to use or manage this sensitive audit-trail key, violating least privilege.
